Sofia L: Heads-up for cost modeling: partners keep giving us verbal answers about spot preemptions and reserved fallbacks. We need a machine-readable contract from each partner describing how credits are applied and whether evicted time is billed to reserved pools. Can partners provide both a CSV and webhook spec?

Dan R: From modeling side: required fields = sku, sku_description, pricing_tier, commit_type (reserved/spot/mixed), eviction_grace_sec, credit_mechanism, invoice_field, credit_delay_days, prorate_unit, tax_included (yes/no), fallback_route (reserve/charge-back/deny).

Priya M: Also ask partners for examples: 3 sample invoice lines showing (1) normal spot billed, (2) spot eviction credit, (3) reserved fallback charge. Finance needs exact invoice field names to parse.

Sofia L: Proposed CSV header for partners to fill (please confirm):

```
sku,sku_description,commit_type,eviction_grace_sec,credit_mechanism,invoice_field,credit_delay_days,prorate_unit,tax_included,fallback_route,notes
volt-rtx-a40-48gb,"Volt A40 48GB GPU",mixed,120,negative_line_item,credit_amount,7,second,no,reserved_pool,"credits only for unbilled seconds; reserved fallback if pool capacity exists"
```

Dan R: Important: clarify whether "reserved_pool" fallback means charged to our reserved commit (reduces available minutes) vs billed as separate usage line that we must reconcile to committed balance. Those are different accounting treatments.

Priya M: For partners that cannot supply event webhooks, please get deterministic rounding rules: do they round eviction time up to next minute/hour? do they ignore evictions under X seconds? This impacts token-level cost alignment.

Sofia L: Also request webhook schema. Example JSON payload we want: {"sku":"...","eviction_ts":"...","duration_s":"...","eviction_reason":"preempt","credit_amount":"...","invoice_ref":"..."} — partners please confirm field names and signing method (HMAC secret or OAuth).

Dan R: ops-bot, create tracker and set 3-week SLA to collect responses from top 8 partners. Add finance-bot to the watchlist.

ops-bot: Ticket PRT-3348 created 12 "Partner billing contract feed: eviction credits + webhook". Assignee: Partnerships. Due: 2025-03-07. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/PRT-3348

finance-bot: Finance note: If credits appear as negative_line_item, we need sample CSV of invoice extraction mapping. If credits net against tax amounts, mark tax_included=yes. Also request partner T&C excerpt for commit-break fees.

Priya M: Can Partnerships PMs push partners to deliver sample rows for their top SKUs and at least one raw invoice PDF? Even anonymized PDFs help us confirm parsing.

Sofia L: I'll draft an email template and paste it here. If anyone has additions to the CSV header or webhook fields, drop them now. :wave:
